title: Coral Starfish | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the coveted Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort, Coral Starfish is a vibrant coastal escape designed for effortless fun and relaxation. This thoughtfully styled three-bedroom, three and a half-bathroom home pairs a bright, open interior with exceptional resort access, placing beaches, pools, dining, and shopping just moments away. A heated communal pool sits steps from the front door, while the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast are only a quick golf cart ride away—made even easier with complimentary use of an 8-seater golf cart. Inside, airy living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, and inviting dining areas create the perfect setting for shared moments and easy living. Each bedroom offers comfort and privacy, featuring two king suites with ensuite baths and a fun bunk room with twin-over-queen beds, ideal for families or groups. Evenings can be spent grilling outdoors, unwinding after a beach day, or exploring nearby Baytowne Wharf with its lively mix of restaurants, shops, and entertainment. With access to championship golf, tennis courts, marina adventures, and miles of scenic trails, Coral Starfish blends coastal charm with resort-style convenience, offering a memorable Destin stay where everything feels within reach.
